title: Google Tests Gemini Daily Brief Text Customization Feature Early Morning AI Summary Receives Precise Fine-Tuning

content_html:
Google is introducing a direct prompt customization feature for Gemini Daily Brief in its Google App 17.43.11 beta version, allowing users to freely adjust the morning AI summary content through text, voice commands, or preset preferences, completely changing the previous fixed-menu interaction logic. This feature first appeared as an extension of Pixel 10 Daily Hub at the 2026 Google I/O conference. This update marks a key step forward in making morning information aggregation tools more deeply personalized.

Technical details show that the new interactive bottom panel not only includes preset options such as "Prioritize email briefings," "Highlight school and schedule," or "Use simpler language," but also provides open text input fields and voice input support. Backend code analysis confirms that this customization mechanism is already working properly, allowing users to actively specify information source priorities and block irrelevant noise. By giving control back to users, Google directly addresses the industry's pain points of homogenized and rigidly formatted first-generation AI summaries, significantly improving the accuracy and practical value of morning information processing.

Although Google has not yet announced a specific release timeline for this feature, this move indicates that generative AI is rapidly shifting from "uniform content delivery" to "intent-driven precise services." In the context of the rapid adoption of multimodal and intelligent agents, seamlessly reconstructing information flows through lightweight prompts will become the standard paradigm for future edge-side AI assistants reshaping user daily habits.

content_html_zh:
谷歌在 Google App 17.43.11 beta 版本中引入了 Gemini Daily Brief 的直接提示定制功能，允许用户通过文字、语音命令或预设偏好自由调整早间 AI 摘要内容，彻底改变以往固定菜单的交互逻辑。 该功能首次作为 Pixel 10 Daily Hub 的扩展出现在 2026 年 Google I/O 大会上。 此次更新标志着晨间信息聚合工具更加个性化的关键一步。

技术细节显示，新的交互式底部面板不仅包括“优先处理电子邮件简报”、“突出学校和日程安排”或“使用更简单的语言”等预设选项，还提供开放的文本输入字段和语音输入支持。 后端代码分析证实，这种定制机制已经正常工作，允许用户主动指定信息源优先级并阻止不相关的噪音。 通过将控制权交还给用户，谷歌直接解决了第一代AI摘要同质化、格式僵化的行业痛点，显着提升了晨间信息处理的准确性和实用价值。

尽管谷歌尚未公布该功能的具体发布时间表，但此举表明生成式AI正在迅速从“统一内容交付”向“意图驱动的精准服务”转变。 在多模态和智能代理快速采用的背景下，通过轻量级提示无缝重构信息流将成为未来边缘侧人工智能助手重塑用户日常习惯的标准范式。
